question: Among the 593 frozen event-blind candidates, how much same-F0 harmonic evidence is supported by the isolated Rhodes/electric-piano source rather than or alongside the frozen BassDI source?

provenance.alignment_limitation: identical file scope supports distributed-coordinate comparison, but shared hardware clock and exact session origin are unestablished

bass.rule: sole frozen original Double Bass observation source; Bass microphone not combined

piano.rule: sole isolated keyboard source in supplied population; interpreted specifically as Rhodes/electric-piano support; no room-mic union

frozen_candidate_pitch_rule: evaluate every already-serialized candidate F0 in its frozen candidate set; never estimate or select a new source-specific F0

audio_frontend.mono: arithmetic channel mean in physical PCM scale

observation_window.end: frozen candidate timestamp plus min(frozen duration, 0.300 seconds)
observation_window.reason: bounded transfer of the prior 260 ms post-event observation scale while retaining candidate-specific persistence up to 300 ms

fixed_f0_support.frame_supported: >=3 prominent partials and harmonic-band/40-1600-Hz energy ratio >=0.12
fixed_f0_support.persistent_support: >=3 consecutive supported frames and >=50% of available frames supported
fixed_f0_support.source_supported: persistent support for at least one frozen candidate F0
fixed_f0_support.aggregation: per-F0 supported-frame fraction, median harmonic ratio, median supported-partial count, and median transferred harmonic score; source support is union across frozen F0 candidates without choosing a new pitch

attribution_classes.NEITHER_SUPPORTED: neither supported with sufficient valid frames
attribution_classes.INDETERMINATE: either source has fewer than 3 valid frames or a checksum/execution invariant prevents classification

descriptive_quantities.bounded_filtering_range_for_new_recovery: PIANO_DOMINANT count is lower bound and ANY_PIANO_SUPPORT count is upper bound on candidates potentially requiring source-specific filtering; neither is proof of contamination

uncertainty: Wilson 95% interval for each class and any-source proportion

classification_gates_primary_127.HIGH: indeterminate <=20% and (PIANO_DOMINANT >=30% or ANY_PIANO_SUPPORT >=60% or ANY_BASS_SUPPORT <=20%)
classification_gates_primary_127.MATERIAL: indeterminate <=20% and neither LOW nor HIGH
classification_gates_primary_127.INDETERMINATE: authority, execution, or replay invariant fails, or indeterminate >20%

interpretation_firewall: Support is retrospective signal consistency, not causal separation or unique physical identity. Unmatched is not synonymous with false; Piano-supported is not automatically contamination; Bass-supported is not automatically a true Bass event; no production attribution or selector claim.

software.environment: isolated temporary venv referencing unchanged frozen packages; no installation
